test.query: WITH ( SELECT groupArray(group) FROM ( SELECT number, timeSeriesTagsToGroup([('tag', toString(number))]) AS group FROM numbers(4096) ORDER BY number ) ) AS groups SELECT timeSeriesGroupToSamplingKey(toUInt64(number % length(groups) + 1)) FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 1000000 FORMAT Null
